name: Bezai
overview: Bezai is identified in Scripture as the head of a Jewish family that returned from Babylonian exile, with the number of his descendants recorded as over three hundred in both Ezra 2:17 and Nehemiah 7:23. This family played a significant role in the post-exilic community, as members of Bezai's lineage were among those who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah, demonstrating their commitment to God's renewed covenantal relationship (Nehemiah 10:18). These references highlight Bezai's family as a faithful and integral part of Israel's restoration under God's providence.
